title: PartyFrames Light
description: Simple party frames, optional portrait pulled from severs actions, status bars, member direction/distance arrow and sever's survival needs indicators. Expand vertically or horizontally, drag and drop where you want them, shift F8 default for setup. Only tested with Sever's actions, may not support other follower frameworks. Requires magelight.
author: nosimo
changelog:
-Teammate status alone no longer qualifies an actor, regardless of SeverActions roster membership.
-Preserves current SeverActions follow state, engine follower links, live player-targeted follow/escort/accompany packages and the supported Hearth camping-package exception.
-Adds Follower included / Follower removed log lines with actor IDs, follow signals and package/target IDs to help diagnose remaining reports
